objective: Make Task Packet validation a fail-closed, repository-scoped write authorization boundary.
acceptance: a versioned strict JSON Schema validates every field and non-empty constraint
repository paths are normalized, relative, contained, and free of symlink escapes
allowed paths cannot overlap read-only or forbidden boundaries
identity and instruction fields have strict scalar and list shapes
commands are validated as evidence instructions and never executed
CI validates every committed Task Packet
adversarial and valid packet tests pass
stop_conditions: robot control or firmware change required
existing packet cannot be migrated without changing its authorized scope
